text: The Right to Housing Toronto network, Sara Beyer and Jonella Evangelista will provide a presentation on its draft Housing Rights Evaluation Framework, intended to track the City’s progress on employing a rights-based approach to its housing policies and programs.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Executive Director, Housing Secretariat to ensure that, as part of the midpoint review of the Housing TO Action Plan, the consultant engages with the Right to Housing Toronto Network on its Housing Rights Evaluation Framework.
